svg.title: Three large paths that cannot be joined into an induced tree
svg.desc: A 25 by 25 grid contains paths of 93, 69, and 45 vertices. Two rings of 44 and 32 forbidden empty cells block all connections between different paths.

g.text: Three large trees that cannot be joined
Crosses: 44 forbidden cells around A, 32 around B
Every cross touches its outer path at least twice.
A connection to an inner path must cross a forbidden ring.
